title: Flat base change of finite-group invariants
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $D$ a commutative $A$-algebra, and $H$ a finite group acting on $D$ by $A$-algebra automorphisms. Put $D^H=\{d\in D:h(d)=d\text{ for all }h\in H\}$. Let $B$ be a commutative $A$-algebra flat over $A$ (tensoring with $B$ preserves exact sequences of $A$-modules). Give $B\otimes_A D$ the action $h(b\otimes d)=b\otimes h(d)$. The canonical map
$$B\otimes_A D^H\longrightarrow (B\otimes_A D)^H,\qquad b\otimes d\longmapsto b\otimes d$$
is an isomorphism of $B$-algebras. Here tensor products are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], with multiplication $(b\otimes d)(b'\otimes d')=bb'\otimes dd'$. No invertibility of $|H|$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0BRH, lemma-base-change-invariants, flat case and its kernel proof; the same kernel proof over a subring fixed by H gives the displayed A-algebra formulation.
